actions.label: 󰖩
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then nmcli radio wifi on; else nmcli radio wifi off; fi'
actions.update_command: sh -c '[ "$(nmcli radio wifi)" = enabled ] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: 󰂯
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then bluetoothctl power on; else bluetoothctl power off; fi'
actions.update_command: sh -c 'bluetoothctl show | grep -q "Powered: yes" && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: 󰀝
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then rfkill block all; else rfkill unblock all; fi'
actions.update_command: sh -c 'rfkill -n -o SOFT list | grep -q "^unblocked" && echo false || echo true'

actions.label: 󰂛
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then swaync-client -dn; else swaync-client -df; fi'

actions.label: 󰍭
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ 1; else wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ 0; fi'
actions.update_command: sh -c 'wpctl get-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ | grep -q MUTED && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: 󰖔
actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then $HOME/.config/waybar/scripts/nightlight.sh on; else $HOME/.config/waybar/scripts/nightlight.sh off; fi'
